newsitem.title: UK: Euro fuel lifts gently, HS barges trade at $93.50.
newsitem.headline: Euro fuel lifts gently, HS barges trade at $93.50.

text.p: High sulphur fuel prices in the main Rotterdam-Antwerp trading area firmed a little on Friday but business was very slow, traders said.
With Europe entering its traditional summer holiday month the market lacked energy. Bunker demand was thin and just one barge trade was seen, at $93.50 a tonne.
A tight high sulphur supply situation, with Russian cracked cargoes getting quickly absorbed and little alternative production, continues to boost the 3.5 percent market to unseasonably high levels.

One percent cargoes stumble along out of fashion, with demand weak and some reported selling of the product into the European bunker market. August swaps dipped to $93/$94, pushing the market into contango
A little industrial demand from Belgium has supported one percent barges, which were pegged at $95/$97 by sellers. But again that market was slow.
